sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

note: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned; this file does not guess which ones, so no per-trophy hidden flag is set. Every name, description and grade below is as PlayStation publishes it, via Exophase and PSNProfiles, who agree on all three. Every guide is written in my own words from the official description; where the description does not state a location, count or method, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; the platinum unlocks on its own the moment the last one lands. Use the roadmap order in this guide so the long grinds (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100% completion) are running in the background from the start.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Play the Gone Fishing mission when the story offers it and finish it. The official description names no chapter, so take it the first time it appears rather than assuming it can be replayed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Story chapters unlock in order, so this is the first chapter trophy and cannot be missed by playing on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Keep playing the main story missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Same as the other chapter trophies: story progress only, no side requirement.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. The last chapter trophy before the finale; finish the chapter's missions in order.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. The description does not name the mission, so play the story to its end; keep a separate save before the finale in case the ending branches.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it appears in the story. Take story missions as they come; the description gives no other requirement.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Heist missions in the story unlock in sequence: play the story until it appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Story-only; no collectible or side condition is stated in the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Play the story until this mission unlocks and complete it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission, a story mission at the airport (VCIA). Finish it when the story offers it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Story-only; complete it when it appears in the mission flow.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, side strand, collectible set, activity and challenge the game counts. This is the last gold before the platinum; check the in-game stats page for what is still missing, since the official description does not list the 100% requirements.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, airtime and stunt tricks add up over normal play and dedicated stunt runs. Track the running total in the stats menu; the description does not say which stunt types count, so vary them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game once: races, fishing, arcade, shooting range, bowling, meditation and the rest. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.source: Official trophy description and the 42-challenge count, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each range's weapons until gold; the count of 42 comes from the trophy trackers, and the official description does not name the ranges or their locations.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location in Leonida. Learn each course once, then race to win; the official description does not list how many locations there are.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: each race counts once, so enter new events rather than repeating one. The description does not say which race types count, so mix drone races, street races and any other race the game offers.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish with Cal when the challenge is offered and outscore him; the official description does not say where Cal fishes or how the scoring works.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game. Find an arcade machine, play one game through to its end: any game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand of missions to its end; the description does not say how many missions his strand has.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand; take his missions whenever they appear.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand of missions to its end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Talk to strangers marked on the map and finish their strands; any 8 count, so pick the ones you find first.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand of missions.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Find each spot and meditate once; the official description does not say how many spots exist or where they are.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's hunt when it is offered and take down the animal he names; the description does not say which animal or where it roams.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards across Leonida until three full sets are done; the description does not list the sets or their sizes.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Photograph or tag spots with the in-game WAiNK feature as you explore; the count climbs with exploration, so do it while travelling between missions.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks tracked in the game menu: finish any 50 across all types; the description does not name them individually.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape together. Build heat with your partner nearby, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one run while keeping the heat: plan an escape route first, since one failed robbery breaks the chain.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicle models and they count as discovered; variety matters, not repeats, so check the vehicle log for what you still need.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with a group, then drop five enemies before it ends; pick a busy shootout so the targets are there.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. The description gives no method: leaving the airport in a plane without booking is the plain reading, but the exact trigger is unconfirmed, so check the linked trackers before attempting it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The description is a joke line with no method stated. It points at the Rhino tank; exactly what to do with one is unconfirmed in the official description, so check the community guides linked here before attempting it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before any alarm: a silent approach, not a smash-and-grab.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault robbery and the getaway; any five vaults count across the whole game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take the cash and break away from the response before it escalates.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover every region of the map: the trophy tracks map coverage, so drive the full state including the smaller towns, not just Vice City.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find and hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida; the description does not list the gangs or their operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to an Ocean Beach bar with a view, order a cocktail and take it in: a quiet moment trophy, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle out through a showroom's frontage; the description does not name which showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at that bowling alley and complete it; the alley's name is the only location the description gives.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The description names no action. It reads as a partnership milestone with Lucia or Jason, but the exact trigger is unconfirmed in the official description, so do not chase it blind: check the linked trackers for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The description points at a story choice. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: a choice trophy may only trigger on one branch, so keep a separate save before major story decisions and choose deliberately.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The description suggests retrying something that first goes wrong. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: it may depend on failing then succeeding at a one-off moment, so keep a save before story set-pieces where a retry is offered.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: The description points at a strange one-off event. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: it may trigger on a single scripted oddity, so explore story oddities when they appear and keep a spare save.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, hit the pins with a melee attack from a moving vehicle: a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect marked bills from robberies and launder them via contacts until $250,000 is clean; the counter is cumulative across the whole game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear until the total passes $100,000: spending counts everywhere, and it stacks with normal play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market; the description does not say how many there are, so check property listings as you earn money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.source: Official trophy description, PlayStation via Exophase and PSNProfiles
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles and register each in the app; variety counts, repeats do not.
